user.description: Enter the IP address of your miner, or leave it empty to scan your network for miners.

scan.description: Scanning your network for miners. This can take up to two minutes.

scan_result.title: Scan Results
scan_result.description: Select a discovered miner to continue, or adjust the options and scan again.

data_description.scan_network: CIDR range to scan, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24. Useful on Home Assistant OS, where automatic detection cannot see your LAN because HA runs in an internal container network.

avalon_options.title: Avalon Miner Options
avalon_options.description: Choose the control mode for your Avalon miner.

data_description.avalon_control_mode: Simple: Basic monitoring via pyasic. Full: Advanced control via CGMiner API (workmode, LED effects, mining switch).

error.no_miners_found: No miners were found on your network. Scan again, optionally entering your network range below.
error.invalid_selection: The selected miner could no longer be found. Scan again.
error.invalid_cidr: Invalid network range. Use CIDR notation, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24.
error.cidr_too_large: Network range is too large to scan (max 1024 addresses).

restart_backend.name: Restart mining on miner
restart_backend.description: Restarts the mining process on a miner.
